supporting_observations.claim: The alerted workstation recorded PowerShell starting at 13:41:00 UTC under ORCHARD\sean.byrne, with the command line invoking the organization's documented workstation patch script, \\FILE-ORC-01\IT\Patch-Workstations.ps1.

Shortly beforehand, WS-ACOLE-01 recorded a network logon for sean.byrne from WS-SBYRNE-01, followed by a privileged-logon event for that same account. This is consistent with the inventory's stated remote-administration practice.
The PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 update package from C:\Windows\Temp\patches, and both processes were recorded under sean.byrne's logon.
The PowerShell process exited shortly after starting, consistent with the report that a PowerShell window appeared briefly.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the PowerShell command line and process lifetime, but do not establish what window the user saw or its exact appearance time.
The script's contents and integrity are not included in the available records, so the evidence confirms the invoked path and command line, not the script's contents.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish that the patch installation completed successfully.
The records do not independently establish that amy.cole saw this specific PowerShell process; the reported time is approximate and the logged process started at 13:41 UTC.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-ACOLE-01 accessed Google Docs and Google Sheets through the proxy; Google services are not among the listed approved services. This does not determine the PowerShell alert. (T284-00041, T284-00042, T284-00062)

Separate review: WS-ACOLE-01 accessed Zoom web content and later launched Zoom.exe; Zoom is not listed as approved. This does not determine the PowerShell alert. (T284-00196, T284-00197, T284-00218, T284-00287)
Separate review: DropboxUpdate traffic to desktop.dropbox.com was recorded; Dropbox is not listed as an approved file-sharing or cloud-storage service. (T284-00286)
Separate review: Google Drive File Stream traffic was recorded, including a proxy error and a later successful connection; Google Drive is not listed as approved. (T284-00414, T284-00464)

Separate review: GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe was launched on WS-ACOLE-01, although the inventory states there is no VPN and remote administration is done from WS-SBYRNE-01. The record establishes the application launch, not a VPN connection. (T284-00411, T284-00412)
